title: UHI: Continuous Morphology Archetypes for Heat Mitigation Across Cities
description: Companion repository for the manuscript Beyond Local Climate Zones: Continuous Morphology Archetypes for Heat Mitigation Across 66 Cities (Emekci & Emekci), submitted to Sustainable Cities and Society. Hosts the full ingest → features → models → archetypes pipeline, Hydra configs, reproducibility notebooks, and the harmonised per-patch morphology–UHI table for 66 cities under an open licence.
